the argument is called `query`, `page`, `value`, which I find more useful names than `value` in all cases. I didn't suggest we should immediately close this PR, just giving my pov in a way that prevented the PR to immediately be merged.

At the end of the day the extracted type didn't seem to bring that much value (to me), since it's a function which takes one argument & returns void, it's ok if that's repeated in every connector (for me)
